raw_user_query: give me a real world example of a uniform motion

orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: Real world examples of uniform motion
orchestrator_output.text_narration:
• Uniform motion happens when an object covers equal distances in equal intervals of time while moving in a straight line.

• A great real-world example is a train running on a straight railway track at a constant speed of 60 kilometers per hour without stopping, speeding up, or slowing down.

• Another simple example is the movement of the second hand of a clock, which continuously covers equal distances on the clock face in equal amounts of time.

• A car moving on a straight, empty highway using cruise control at a steady speed of 50 kilometers per hour is also in uniform motion.

• The rotation of Earth on its axis at a constant speed, taking exactly 24 hours for one full turn, is a natural example of uniform motion.
